result.title: E2I-Flow: EEG-to-Image Reconstruction via Wavelet-Temporal Cross-Attention and Conditional Flow Matching
result.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based visual decoding and reconstruction aims to recover visual information from non-invasive brain signals. But there are challenges due to the complex temporal-frequency characteristics of EEG signals and the difficulty of discrete denoising framework in mapping neural activity to meaningful visual representations. Here, we propose E2I-Flow, an EEG-to-image decoding and reconstruction framework that combines a novel EEG encoder for time-frequency representation learning from EEG features, and conditional flow matching for visual decoding. A stationary-wavelet frequency branch and a temporal-mixing branch are integrated through bidirectional cross-attention and adaptive fusion, with the resulting EEG representations aligned to ground-truth image embeddings using contrastive and mean-squared-error loss supervisions. The aligned EEG representation is then used as a condition for a Transformer-based flow-matching model to predict the corresponding visual embedding for image synthesis. Experimental results show strong zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval and improved visual reconstruction performance, outperforming several state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 E2I-Flow，用小波-时序双分支 EEG 编码器加双向交叉注意力和自适应融合获得脑电表征，并以对比与 MSE 损失对齐图像嵌入，再用 Transformer 条件 flow matching 生成图像嵌入以重建视觉图像。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于 EEG 到图像的跨模态重建，条件 flow matching 仅用于合成图像嵌入，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、证据获取或答案使用，与 latent visual reasoning 主线缺少可核查的状态、训练或决策层面联系。
